description: This file is a shell script for rewriting git revision history, including functions for commit filtering, ref rewriting, and state management, used in git filter-branch operations.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message to standard error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps commit identifiers, using a stored mapping or returning the original if not rewritten.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Skips a commit by mapping its parents.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a commit only if the tree has changed, otherwise skips.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Ensures non-empty author/committer identity and exports related variables.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Sets author and committer identities from a commit.
